description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - room sweep: the bedtime check of a child's room that never feels done - window, socket covers, small objects on the floor, bed rail, door, night light. You walk the room in the order you entered it and check each item by looking at it and confirming: an item only turns green when YOU looked at it and said it is fine, a problem item stays flagged and is never brushed green, and the summary only says 'you can sleep now' when every item is green. Missed items are named with their walk-order sector before you finish, so nothing is left to a vague feeling. Photos are an optional session-only archive marker per item (wide photo, memory only, never analysed, never judged by the agent) - the agent never detects a physical state and never connects to home devices: whether the window is shut or the socket is covered is your judgement, made by looking. Everything lives in session memory only and is wiped when the agent closes, so tomorrow night you sweep again.
name: room-sweep
